register_objects365_splits: import this module to auto-register objects365_v2_train, objects365_v2_val, and objects365_v2_val_rare splits with detectron2
get_builtin_metadata: call _get_builtin_metadata to get thing_dataset_id_to_contiguous_id and thing_classes for the 365 objects365 categories
review_categories_v2_fix: review the categories_v2_fix list of 365 manually typo-corrected object category id and name pairs
inspect_predefined_splits: inspect _PREDEFINED_SPLITS_OBJECTS_365 to see the train val and val_rare image root and annotation json paths
summarize_objects365_registration: summarize how this module registers the objects365 v2 dataset with 80k images and 1.24m annotations into detectron2
